name: Hefei University of Technology
supervisors: Ministry of Education (co-built with MIIT, the Anhui government and SASTIND)

evidence.summary: In 2018 SASTIND and the Ministry of Education added Hefei University of Technology, with seven other universities, to the universities they co-build in 2016–2020, to support defence-specialty disciplines, defence research bases and teams, and training for the defence industry.
HFUT describes itself as a key university run directly by the Ministry of Education and co-built by the ministry with MIIT and the Anhui government.

sources.title: 工科发展的新机遇：我校等8所高校获批国防科工局与教育部共建高校 (Eight universities, including Hefei University of Technology, approved as co-built by SASTIND and the Ministry of Education; 1 August 2018)
